name: We Are Not Angels Radio
source:
The universe needs energy to expand. X and Y are variables, interstellar life-forms with the ability to convert entire planets into energy. Version 'radio' follows X, who crash lands in the modern state of Sasu. While searching for her partner Y, X attempts to rationalize eventually obliterating an innocent world.

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/wearenotangelsradio.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
宇宙需要能量来膨胀。X和Y是变量，是能够将整个行星转化为能量的星际生命形式。“无线电”版本讲述了X坠毁在现代萨苏州的故事。在寻找伴侣Y的过程中，X试图合理化，最终毁灭了一个无辜的世界。

[来自[url=http://renai.us/game/wearenotangelsradio.shtml]仁爱档案[/url]]
